mapper.select: SELECT * FROM permission WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY order_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (name, code, url, method, parent_id, order_num, icon, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{url}, #{method}, #{parentId}, #{orderNum}, #{icon}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1
